subject: ours:maintain-verification-skill
why: Owner rulings of 2026-11-14 on the verification units (decisions 1-11, 13 and 15 as recommended, cited R1-R15; scratchpad/mvp-stack/owner-rulings-2026-11-13.md, "Verification units, before building"), the create-verification-skill rulings Q1, Q2 and A-D (same file) and "Maintain proof and formal pair" items 7 (the proof setup) and 9 (plan 82 Q1 option (a)), plan 82. New manual skill (R1; its description says it drives the real app, R2): one pass keeps a project's existing verify skill and its feature map true to the product. It finds the target by content in every skills folder the project's hosts read (R5), checks the index, reads every feature from source (a sizeable one through a read-only helper), drives each live through the target's own helper, fixes proven doc drift, omitted prerequisites and harness gaps, and ends clean, changed or blocked, its fixes left uncommitted for land (R10). Short guardrails are restated in its own words (R3) and the sibling's two references are reused by pointer, not copied (R4); a fix keeps the target's fixed sections (R8); a missing tool is installed only by the recipe the target records (R6); contract gaps are follow-ups (item 9). The sibling's handover pointer is now a checked slash pointer (R11); the unit ships in the plugin at the authorized publish (R15). Proven on equity-os's verify-eqos with a planted flag drift, in its own worktree with its own throwaway Postgres, offline (R12, item 7): the first pass failed on the read-back rule (82c), the unit was clarified, and a fresh pass from a fresh copy and plant passed with outcome changed (82e); browser and desktop unproven. Placement engineering · Improvement · Codification, secondary Testing, boundary against create-verification-skill, review and check-invariants. 39 traits: 28 adopted (the 32 pending adopts below), 9 existing reused (A-D, Q1, R1, R3, R10 as the maintenance pass applies them) and 2 of ours (installed-recipe-or-blocked, contract-gaps-reported).
